gen.//: `gen` must not declare a path inside `build`'s output directory. It did (`dist/custom-elements.json`), which nx's own guidance forbids: two targets owning overlapping paths makes a restore of one able to disturb the other. `build` owns `dist`; `gen` owns `src/generated`. The emptying of `dist` this note used to call unidentified had a second overlap of the same kind, found 2026-08-28: the `typecheck` target the @nx/js/typescript plugin infers runs `tsc --build --emitDeclarationOnly` and declares `dist` as ITS output too, so a cache hit on it restored a declaration-only snapshot over the full dist. Every package's project.json now defines `typecheck` explicitly as `tsc --noEmit` with no outputs (a targetDefault does not override an inferred target's options — measured), see the `typecheck` target below.

typecheck.//: Explicit, so the @nx/js/typescript plugin's inferred one (tsc --build --emitDeclarationOnly, outputs: dist) is not used: that one emits into the dist that build owns and declares it as an output, and a cache hit on it restored a declaration-only snapshot over the full dist. A typecheck writes nothing and claims nothing.
